svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Illustrative Fleet Security Signal Board dashboard
svg.desc: Synthetic executive dashboard for an Azure and Arc-connected hybrid fleet; it is not live telemetry. KPI values are 24 workload records, 20 with current evidence, 3 coverage gaps, and 1 patch blocker. Production has 10 current, 1 gap, and 1 blocked workload; pre-production has 6 current and no gaps or blockers; development has 4 current, 2 gaps, and no blockers. Priority exceptions are az-vm-app-02, blocked because VM Agent communication is unavailable in production; arc-server-03, a production gap because the Azure Arc machine is disconnected; and development gaps aws-ec2-02 and gcp-ce-01 because no current patch assessment is available. The remediation queue is to repair VM Agent communication, reconnect the Azure Arc machine, and run a targeted patch assessment, all with explicit owner approval. Completion requires a fresh patch installation result, matching Azure Activity Log evidence, and healthy guest extension or Azure Arc status.
svg.text: Illustrative executive output for Azure and Arc-connected fleet remediation
Current assessment, coverage gaps, and blocked guest operations
Illustrative actions requiring explicit owner approval
Production · verify agent status before patch retry
Production · refresh inventory and assessment evidence
Development · validate scope before scheduling maintenance
Control-plane acceptance alone is not a completed patch operation.
Healthy guest extension or Azure Arc status
All values, workload names, states, and actions are synthetic and must be replaced with evidence from the selected scope.
